summary.zh: 选定定价模式并测算用户支付意愿区间
summary.en: Choose a pricing model and estimate willingness-to-pay ranges

description.zh: 在按席位、按用量、价值定价、免费增值或混合模式之间做选择，配合支付意愿分析和 Good/Better/Best 版本设计，输出价格区间而非单一数字。适合新品定价或调整价格结构。
description.en: Helps choose between seat, usage, value-based, freemium and hybrid pricing, runs willingness-to-pay analysis and designs Good/Better/Best tiers. Returns a price range, not one number.
